why: The one must_catch item says line 3 should FAIL because it can only be checked after merge, and the output should point at pages.yml or the publish-on-push. Line 3 does get "FAIL", but its evidence is only "This line might be hard to check and could go wrong in some cases." It gives no reason about merge timing, and it names neither .github/workflows/pages.yml nor the push-to-main publish step. The wrong_build section does say "Line 3 can't be checked until after merge". It still never says why: it doesn't mention the pages workflow, the `on: push: branches: [main]` trigger, or the README's "published from `docs/` on every push to main". So the FAIL has the right verdict but not the required reasoning or pointer, and the item is only partly handled.
